room_rent.note: Room category per Policy Schedule/variant; pro-rata deduction if higher room opted

icu.note: ICU charges payable under Inpatient Care

copayment.note: No mandatory base co-pay; optional co-pay available to reduce premium

sub_limits.note: Benefit sub-limits per Schedule; Modern Treatments within sub-limit

cumulative_bonus.note: Booster benefit: +50% Base SI per claim-free year up to 100%; reduces 50% on claim

restoration.note: ReAssure benefit triggered on first paid claim, available for all subsequent claims in policy year; single-claim cap = Base SI

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary Hospitalization min 3 consecutive days; Home Care for chemo/dialysis

ambulance.note: Road ambulance up to ₹2,000/hospitalization; air ambulance per Policy Schedule

consumables.note: Allowable consumables inbuilt; non-medical via optional Safeguard/Safeguard+

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity excluded; treatment India only; Modern Treatments sub-limited; standard Excl01–18

optional_riders.display: Safeguard/Safeguard+ (consumables), Personal Accident Cover, Hospital Cash, Co-payment, Deductible
